runtime.description: The Necropolis raises tireless undead armies through skeleton growth, death magic, attrition, and late-stack scaling. Death knights and necromancers rely on immunities, drain, death cloud, curse, and dragon terror rather than living morale.

allowedDebt: Necropolis is currently a manifest/registry scaffold with source plugin unit import rows, bundles, static portraits, preview manifests, lab sidecars, hero portraits, faction art, city billboard art, and dwelling billboard frames present. It is not a promoted release Core overlay and still needs town/build-tree presentation, UI exposure, and mechanics validation.

The current manifest schema is suffix-based, so display names preserve Skeleton Warrior, Zombie, Wraith, Vampire Lord, Power Lich, Dread Knight, and Ghost Dragon while stable SIDs remain h3_<base>_upg until the schema supports explicit per-variant SIDs.
The tier-4 Guard branch, Skeleton Sharpshooter, and Dracolich are documented ToA extras but are outside the current seven-line faction manifest contract.

Necromancy rank tuning and specialist presentation, Skeleton Transformer, Cover of Darkness, undead immunity parity, Lich death cloud, Vampire Lord life drain, Wraith mana drain, Ghost Dragon aging, and chance-proc-to-focus conversions remain static-trace/mechanics debt.
Bone/Ghost/Spectral Dragon currently uses Dungeon Black Dragon as the visual donor while release Core generation must preserve Undead legality/immunity data.
Necropolis donor reverse lookup must remain context-required because Undead donor units and barracks can also appear as native game content.
